description: This file contains functions and logic for lowering tuple constructs within the Torch JIT compiler, including flattening tuple inputs/outputs, removing tuple nodes, and handling tuple constants in the graph.

methods.name: flattenTupleInLoopParams
methods.description: Flattens tuple parameters in loop nodes by inserting a TupleConstruct node and adjusting inputs.

methods.name: flattenTupleInBlockReturn
methods.description: Flattens tuple outputs of a block node and updates outer block uses.

methods.name: removeTupleNodes
methods.description: Removes tuple unpacking, indexing, and slicing nodes, replacing them with their constituent values.

methods.name: RemoveTupleConstants
methods.description: Replaces tuple constants with individual constant nodes for each element.

methods.name: flattenInputs
methods.description: Flattens tuple inputs in a node, replacing tuple inputs with their elements.

methods.name: flattenOutputs
methods.description: Flattens tuple outputs of a node, replacing tuple outputs with their elements.

methods.name: VisitNode
methods.description: Processes a node to flatten tuple inputs/outputs and remove tuple nodes.

methods.name: LowerAllTuples
methods.description: Recursively lowers all tuples in a graph, including parameters and return values.

methods.name: LowerSimpleTuples
methods.description: Simplifies tuple structures in a graph without fully lowering all tuples.
